task: What are the onboard activities of the cheapest cruise, departing from Los Angeles that lasts at least 8 days?
agent_final_answer:
The cheapest cruise departing from Los Angeles that lasts at least 8 days is the "8-Day Mexican Riviera from Long Beach (Los Angeles), CA" on the Carnival Panorama, priced from $431 per person.

Its onboard activities (listed under "Things to Do" for the Fun Day at Sea) are:
1. Bonsai Teppanyaki (Additional cost)
2. Sky Zone (Additional cost)
3. Havana Bar (Additional cost)
4. Slots (Additional cost)
5. Playlist Productions (Included)
6. White Hot Night Party (Included)
7. Space Cruisers (Included)
8. WaterWorks (Included)
9. Cloud 9 Spa: Thermal Suite (Additional cost)
